title: Your First Weekend at Colgate University, Shared as Cards
description: A guide to the essential traditions and campus landmarks for new students during their first weekend on the hill.

cards.title: Arrive on the Hill
cards.subtitle: The official start of your journey
cards.notes: Pass the 'Honk If You Love Colgate' sign and head to Whitnall Field to unload. Volunteers will help you move into your Residential Commons.
cards.short_summary: The first official day for new students to move into residence halls and begin orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: Arrival Day for domestic students is Sunday, August 23, 2026, featuring the 'Honk If You Love Colgate' tradition and unloading at Whitnall Field.
cards.access_notes: Check-in begins in the morning; specific times are assigned by the university.

cards.title: First Meal at Frank
cards.subtitle: The social heart of campus dining
cards.notes: Grab your first meal with new roommates. Look for the omelet station, a student favorite, and enjoy the views from the hilltop windows.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining facility for first-year students, known for its social atmosphere and variety of food stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Frank Dining Hall is a central social hub for students and is open from 6:30 a.m. to midnight during the week.
cards.source_title: Colgate's Dining Staff: The Heart Behind Colgate's Dining Halls - The Colgate Maroon-News
cards.access_notes: Open daily; late-night dining typically resumes once the full semester begins.

cards.title: Gear Up Downtown
cards.subtitle: Three floors of books and apparel
cards.notes: Take the shuttle downtown to pick up your textbooks and a maroon sweatshirt. It is the largest independent bookstore in Central New York.
cards.short_summary: The university-owned bookstore located in downtown Hamilton, offering textbooks, apparel, and gifts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colgate Bookstore is located at 3 Utica St. and is open Saturdays from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

cards.title: Stroll Willow Path
cards.subtitle: A scenic campus landmark
cards.notes: Walk along the edge of Taylor Lake on the historic Willow Path. It is a perfect spot for a quiet moment or a first-weekend photo.
cards.short_summary: A picturesque lake and tree-lined walkway on the lower campus, central to many university traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor Lake and Willow Path are landmark sites for memories and traditions, created in the early 1900s for campus beautification.
cards.source_title: Beloved landmarks: Taylor Lake and the Willow Path | Colgate at 200 Years

cards.title: Celebrate at ALANA
cards.subtitle: A signature start-of-year event
cards.notes: Join the ALANA Cultural Center for food, music, and community building. It is a key event for meeting students from all backgrounds.
cards.short_summary: An annual celebration hosted by the ALANA Cultural Center to welcome students at the start of the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: ALANA Palooza is a signature event at the beginning of each academic year for connecting and celebrating the community.
cards.source_title: ALANA Cultural Programs and Initiatives | Colgate University
cards.access_notes: Typically held during the first week or weekend of the fall semester.

cards.title: Visit the Trudy Center
cards.subtitle: Sustainable wellness on two floors
cards.notes: Check out the LEED Gold-certified gym. Use the cardio machines upstairs or weights downstairs to stay active between orientation sessions.
cards.short_summary: The university's primary fitness facility, featuring modern equipment and sustainable design.
cards.evidence_claim: The Trudy Fitness Center is free for all Colgate students and was the university's first LEED-certified facility.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid Colgate ID for entry; hours vary by season.

cards.title: Explore the Village Green
cards.subtitle: The heart of the Hamilton community
cards.notes: Walk down the hill to the center of town. The Green hosts community events and is surrounded by local shops and cafes.
cards.short_summary: A central park in the Village of Hamilton that serves as a gathering place for students and residents.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hamilton Village Green is located at 1-13 Broad St. and hosts events like the Colgate Day of Service and local festivals.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Case Library and Geyer Center
cards.notes: Explore five floors of resources. Find a quiet cubby or a group study room to prepare for your first week of classes.
cards.short_summary: The main university library, providing extensive print and digital collections and diverse study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Case Library and Geyer Center for Information Technology is a five-story facility with nearly 818,000 print volumes.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on Sundays during the academic year; 24-hour access available during finals.

cards.title: Watch the First Sunset
cards.subtitle: A hilltop tradition for the new class
cards.notes: Gather on the hill behind Burke and Pinchin Halls. Enjoy food and music while watching the sun go down with your entire class.
cards.short_summary: A traditional orientation event where the incoming class gathers to watch the sunset from the campus hillside.
cards.evidence_claim: The First Sunset tradition involves the new class gathering on the hill behind Burke and Pinchin Halls to watch the sunset together.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of the official orientation program.

cards.title: Attend Convocation
cards.subtitle: The formal welcome to the community
cards.notes: Process to the academic quad and enter the Memorial Chapel. This ceremony officially marks the beginning of your academic journey.
cards.short_summary: The capstone event of orientation that formally initiates the first-year class into the university's academic community.
cards.evidence_claim: Founders' Day Convocation is the official welcome into Colgate's academic tradition, featuring a formal procession to the Memorial Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Required for all first-year students; business casual attire is encouraged.
